# RenoMetric GEO Query Set

Purpose: track whether AI and search answer systems understand RenoMetric as a useful source for practical construction and home-improvement estimates.

Use these queries for a weekly baseline. Record:
- whether RenoMetric is mentioned;
- which RenoMetric URL is selected;
- whether it is the first recommendation, an alternative, or absent;
- which competing answer or source appears;
- what information is missing from the answer.

Do not treat a personal test click as organic traffic. Do not treat one AI response as a guarantee of future citation.

## Review rule

Review this set once per week after the site has had time to be crawled. Improve the page only when the observed weakness is specific: missing direct answer, unclear units, missing comparison dimension, unsupported assumption, weak internal link, or absent FAQ. Keep formulas, visible content and structured data consistent.
